summary: CitroTech Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Stock Exchange and Stockholders Agreements on May 28, 2026. The issuer reacquired 1,666,667 shares of Series A Preferred Stock, issuing 103,558 shares of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock to BoltRock Holdings at closing and agreeing to issue 467,012 shares to TC Special Investments after 18 months or upon a change of control (including board appointment of Theodore S. Ralston). No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. The transactions eliminate all Series A Preferred Stock and grant board observer/registration rights. Watch for future issuances and potential control shifts.
